text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An exhibition race has been proposed to give popular Umamusume the opportunity to show their full potential—the Gekkei Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon, the tireless pursuer of Umamusume potential, has also received an invitation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this many talented runners, it's a prime opportunity for collecting data. However, Agnes Tachyon struggles to decide if she should enter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She goes out later that night for a run. Somewhat resigned, she makes a choice for her future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, she conveys to me her intention to run in the Gekkei Hai.
